analysis.ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version 7.1.5-0+deb13u1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
analysis.decode: FFmpeg mono f32le; source assets read-only; analysis resampling only
analysis.loudness: FFmpeg loudnorm input_i/input_tp, BS.1770/EBU R128; delivered file, no tiling or added silence
analysis.spectrum: Welch one-sided density, Hann 8192, 50% overlap, nfft8192, no detrend; unweighted energy
analysis.band_convention: Half-open [a,b); above_2khz is strictly f >2000, denominator all bins through Nyquist
analysis.tonality: Any Welch/time-local narrow peak >2kHz, >=12dB above median +/-80Hz excluding +/-12Hz, >=-55dB relative max40-2000Hz PSD, width<=30Hz fails
analysis.maximum_rate_test: Decode first, rational resample to simulate manifest maximum playbackRate; repeat high-band and Welch/time-local tonal checks
analysis.loop: Manifest central loop. Raw last-to-first step includes ordinary waveform slope and is reported without an absolute acceptance limit. Acceptance: error abs(x[start]-x[end]) against actual decoded codec continuation <=-42dBFS, seam step <=6x interior first-difference p99, and the larger of the two seam second differences <=6x interior second-difference p99. No seam-to-silence assumption. Log floor1e-30 maps exact equality to-600dBFS.
analysis.baseline_mapping: Only brake-loop light/medium/hard have direct v4 replacements. Side scrape/bumps are context; v4 has no pit, offtrack, deceleration or shift assets.
